title: Sweet Potato Baked Onion Bhajis
ingredients: 2 small sweet potatoes, pricked and microwaved for 7 minutes
steps: Fry onions gently in cooking spray for ~10 minutes until soft and golden. Cool for a few minutes.
Scoop sweet potato flesh into a bowl; mash with a fork.
Add egg, spices and salt to sweet potato; combine to make a batter. Stir in cooled fried onions.
Line a baking tray with parchment; shape mixture into ~12 bhajis with your hands.
Spray thoroughly with cooking spray; bake 45 minutes until golden and crisp.
notes: Quick yogurt and mint dip: mix 250g fat-free yogurt, handful of finely chopped mint, 1 crushed garlic clove, 1 tbsp lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
